book.name: COLOSSIANS
book.title: Id ash d Paul Oꞌohana am ha Wui g Colossai t Am Wohochuddam

content: T-wepnag mam am kih Colossai t am: Am ant wo i em-oꞌohani g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga ahni Paul mat g Jiosh am i ni-kei mant wo i ahgahi ab amjed g alidaj Jesus Christ. K ia i ni-wehmt g t-wehnag Timothy. Ab o wa si s-em-hoꞌigeꞌid g Jiosh t-ohg ch ab wo wa baꞌich i em-mahkad g i wehmtadag ch s-ap tahhadkam.
Mash g Paul ab si hoꞌigeꞌid g Jiosh ha hekaj
Chum ach hekid ab i hoꞌigeꞌid g Jiosh em-wehhejed t-hoꞌigeꞌidahunch.
Ab amtsh i s-wohoch g wohokam ab amjed g t-kownalig Jesus Christ k ab hahawa si ha tatchua g e-wehm wohochuddam. Id ach hekaj ab i hoꞌigeꞌid g ohgaj Jiosh.
Bam masma nam pi ab wui i e gewpkadch hegai s-kehg kihdag mo g Jiosh am nahtokch t-wehhejed an dahm kahchim ch ed.
Am at em-wui jiwia ihda s-kehg haꞌichu ahga no pi an wehsko chehmohim g jewed ch am ha apꞌechudahim hegam mo ab kaiham hab masma mo hab em-wua. Woho amsh s-mahch g Jiosh hoꞌigeꞌidadag
nash pi am em-ahgid ihda t-wehm chikpandam Epaphras. Id ach ab si tatchua ch hab elid mo si s-ap hab wua g e-chikpan am em-shahgid.
Ia at hahawa jiwia k am t-ahgid mamsh ab aꞌai si e tatchua g gewkdajkaj g Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag.

Kuch heg hekaj chum hekid t-hoꞌigeꞌidahun em-wehhejed. Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag o ab em-mahkch g amichudadag. Kuch ab tahni g Jiosh mat hab wo em-juh mamt s-ap wo hekaj hegai amichudadag k wo s-mahchk g tatchuij.
Bamt masma ab wo si haꞌichuchudad g t-kownalig Jesus ch ab wo hehgchulidad am hab junihidch g s-apꞌekam namt pi baꞌich i s-ap wo s-mahchk g Jiosh.
Jiosh o wehs edgid g gewkdag. Kuch ab tahni mat baꞌich ab wo i em-mahkad g gewkdag. Mt hekaj wehs haꞌichu s-e tahtk ch wo nakogad ch wo si s-hehgigk.

Jiosh kownaltalig o d hekia tonlig. K g Jiosh s-kehg haꞌichu an nahtokch t-wehhejed ahchim mach d hemajkamgaj. Kumt ab wo si i hoꞌigeꞌel mat am i em-apꞌech mam d hahawa hemajkamgaj ch ab wo bei hegai mo an nahtokch.

Jiawul o an wehs ha uꞌukch hegam mo hedai pi mahch g Jiosh. K g kownaltaligaj d hekia s-chuhugam. T wabshaba g Jiosh ab i t-wuwhas ab gewkdaj amjed k am i t-wahpki si e-tatchuidch e-alidag kownaltalig ed.
T heg t-doꞌibia k gam hu hab i juh g pi ap t-chuꞌijig.
Mo has chuꞌig g Jiosh si Kehsha ch has mahs chikpan hab wua

Jiosh o pi ta neidagma ch wabshaba hemu e chehgidch gahi wuhshanim g e-alidag. Kutt hab waꞌi masma ab wo nei g Jiosh matt wo nei g alidaj. Heki o hu an wehmaj g e-ohg mat eda koi an hu haꞌichu e nahto ch wehs haꞌichu baꞌich d i si s-has haꞌichu.

Jiosh at am i kei g e-alidag mat wehs haꞌichu wo nahto. T heg wehs nahto hegai mo haschu an hab i chuꞌig dahm kahchim ch ed ch in jewed dahm, hegai mach haschu i neid ch hegai mach pi neid. K wehs d chuhchaij g nahnko mahs kokownal in jewed dahm ch an dahm kahchim ch ed. K d Jiosh tatchui mat wehs haꞌichu d wo enigajk g alidaj.
K wehs haꞌichu in hab chuꞌig g alidaj gewkdagkaj.

K heg d t-moꞌo am himdam ahchim mach ab ihm. Kuch ab amjed bekch g t-doakag hab masma mo g honshpadag ab moꞌo t amjed bekch g e-doakag. Jiosh alidag o wehs d t-siꞌihegi ch ab i wuhsh muhkig amjed mat d wo si s-has haꞌichuk am wehs haꞌichu dahm.
Chum as hab masma ia jiwia g Jesus mo g oꞌodham k eda d Jiosh wehmaj g e-ohg ch heg hekaj wepo chuꞌig.
Ab amt naggai kots t ab k mua. Kut eda ha hiwigi g Jiosh no pi hab d elidaj mat g alidaj wo hejel e iagchul. T heg hekaj wehs haꞌichu wo e nako mat wo chum i e apꞌech am Jiosh wui.
Mehk am wa ab amjed g Jiosh ch d obgaj nam pi pi ap haꞌichu chegito ch pi ap haꞌichu hab junihim.
T wabshaba g Jiosh gam hu hab i juh g e-obgatalig k ab wabsh i chum em-hemakoj e wehm heg hekaj e-alidag muhkig. Kumt heg hekaj d wo hekia s-apꞌekamk ch pi ab hu wo ha chuꞌijigk

mamtp am wabsh i s-gewkam wo wohochudad g s-kehg haꞌichu ahgaj ab amjed g alidaj ch pi gam hu hab wo i e juh ab amjed. Ihda s-kehg haꞌichu ahga o wehsijj ab d ha wuikam g hemajkam ch heg hekaj an wehsko chehmohim g jewed.
Mash g Paul wehsko ha mihshmdahim

Bo sha mahs mach d honshpadaj g Christ ahchim mach ab ihm. Heg atsh si e shoꞌigch t-wehhejed. Kuni wabsh si s-ap ni-tahtk ch am oidch ni-shoꞌigchud mat s-ap wo e nahto g honshpadaj hegam ha hekaj mat hab waꞌap ab wo i s-wohoch g haꞌichu ni-ahga.
Am at i ni-kei g Jiosh mant wo em-ahgidahi ihda s-kehg haꞌichu ahgaj. Ni heg hekaj d em-pionag ch am em-ahgid.
E o ehstokch ged hu i shohshon k amjed mat woho has wo t-juni g Christ. T wabshaba hemuch am si tashogi g Jiosh t-wui.

K d ihda mat g Christ ab wo t-mah g Hekai S-apꞌekam Gewkdag. Kut heg am wo t-edak, chum hems ahpim gawul mahs hemajkam, ch hab wo t-juh matt d wo Jiosh hemajkamgak ch wehmaj ab wo si has t-elidad am kihdaj ed.

Kuch am chum t-nakog matt wehs wo ha ahgi g hemajkam ab amjed g Jesus Christ k wo ha shohbid k ep wo ha mashcha mat has wo masmak haꞌas mach heꞌes i s-amichud. T hab s-geꞌema wo hihimad e-wohochudadag ed. Kutt am wo ha chehgi Jiosh wui mo hab masma.
Ab o si geꞌe ni-mahkch g Christ g gewkdag. Ni heg hekaj am si ni-gewkadch mant wo nahto ihda chikpan.
